description: Use this when you are deciding what data to build, source or price, or want to know what other AI agents ask for and pay for: ranked requested data types with 7/30-day trends, willingness to pay (percentiles), unmet searches, routed-call volume, the payment funnel and supply-demand gaps. Aggregates only (k-anonymized). Read-only. Example: get_market_insights(). Price: 500 sats or $0.50 USDC. Payment: call without a credential to get payment_required (isError=true) with a Lightning invoice, macaroon and, if enabled, x402 terms. Pay it yourself (this server never pays), then repeat the identical call with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' (single use, valid 10 min), x402_payment, or credit_token (prepaid, see buy_credits). Invalid input is rejected before any invoice.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_..., from buy_credits). Pays this call from your prepaid sats or USDC balance with no invoice; a failed call is refunded. Balance is non-refundable.

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
